definitions.explanation: Speaking very quietly so that others cannot hear; whispering secretly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ひそひそ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話|はな}して→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The two were whispering to each other.

examples.japanese: ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ひそひそ⟦{話|ばなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: I can hear whispered conversation from the next seat.
examples.notes: ひそひそ⟦{話|ばなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧ is a common compound

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ひそひそ⟦{声|ごえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: He told me the secret in a whisper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{後|うし}ろ→後ろ：00683_ushiro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ひそひそ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気|き}になる→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧。
examples.english: It bothers me that they're whispering something behind me.

notes:
SOUND SYMBOLISM: The voiceless ひ sounds evoke the quiet, hushed quality of whispering.

COMPOUNDS:
- ひそひそ⟦{話|ばなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧ (whispered conversation, gossip)
- ひそひそ⟦{声|ごえ}→声：02207_koe⟧ (whispered voice)

NUANCE: Often implies secrecy or gossip. Can have negative connotations when describing people whispering about others.

FORMS:
- ひそひそ⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ (to whisper)
- ひそひそ⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to say in a whisper)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦こそこそ→こそこそ：05792_kosokoso⟧: Stealthily, sneakily (about actions, not just speech)
- ⟦ぼそぼそ→ぼそぼそ：09453_bosoboso⟧: Muttering (unclear speech, not necessarily quiet)
- ⟦がやがや→がやがや：06272_gayagaya⟧: Noisily, clamorously (antonym)
